# arin_customer (Data Source)

Read an existing reassignment customer. Customer data is marked sensitive but remains in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
# This data source stores sensitive content in Terraform state.
data "arin_customer" "example" {
  handle = "C00000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String, Sensitive) Customer handle.

### Read-Only

- `city` (String, Sensitive) city returned by ARIN.
- `comments` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered lines of comments.
- `country_calling_code` (String, Sensitive) country calling code returned by ARIN.
- `country_code` (String, Sensitive) country code returned by ARIN.
- `country_code3` (String, Sensitive) country code3 returned by ARIN.
- `country_name` (String, Sensitive) country name returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String, Sensitive) name returned by ARIN.
- `parent_org_handle` (String, Sensitive) parent org handle returned by ARIN.
- `postal_code` (String, Sensitive) postal code returned by ARIN.
- `private_customer` (Boolean, Sensitive) private customer returned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String, Sensitive) registration date returned by ARIN.
- `street_address` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered lines of street address.
- `subdivision` (String, Sensitive) subdivision returned by ARIN.
